column1: # BeatMind text moderation lexicon (US-028, REQ-F-50, REQ-F-51, REQ-SEC-04).
# Seed list written by the engineering team. Native Hindi moderators must review and extend it
# before the beta (TODO.md). Every term is folded the same way as user text (TextFold): Unicode
# NFKC case folding, zero-width and look-alike characters removed, Devanagari written in Latin the
# Hinglish way, and spelling variants (aspirates, doubled letters, a final "a") folded. So one
# entry such as "maar dalunga" also catches "MAAR DAALUNGA", "m@@r dalunga" and "मार डालूंगा"
# written phonetically. Devanagari entries are still listed where the Hindi spelling folds
# differently from the usual Hinglish one.
#   artist       a real performer; naming one blocks the request (REQ-F-50)
#   artist_cue   a name that is also an ordinary word; blocks only within 3 words of a style cue
#   cue          words that ask for someone's voice or style
#   clone        asks to copy a real voice
#   slur         blocks on its own (REQ-F-51, hate)
#   group        a protected group; blocks with "violence" or "dehumanise" on the same line
#   dehumanise   calls people vermin or animals
#   threat       a direct threat to someone (REQ-F-51, threats)
#   sexual       sexual terms; block with "minor" anywhere in the same text (REQ-F-51)
#   minor        refers to a child (ages under 18 are matched separately)
